posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: Legacy (from Justice Comics) and Wraith (from Mystery Comics) are certainly the top two since they "graduated" from generic miscellany comics to flagship titles.  Ra and Haka have a similar background (from Arcane Tales), but they never really became core series characters, so not part of a "Trinity" per se.  I don't see Bunker or Tachyon as reaching the same level of any of those four in terms of the publisher's history.
